slides.title: Faster deploys, fewer pages
slides.text: What changed in the pipeline, what it cost and what we do next.
slides.notes: Open with the one-line result: median deploy 31 min to 9 min.

slides.title: Median deploy
slides.caption: Down from 31 min in Q3, measured across 1,240 production deploys.
slides.notes: Source: the deploy log, production only.

slides.title: Three changes did most of the work
items: Integration tests split into four parallel shards
Canary stage replaced the manual smoke test
slides.notes: The cache alone accounts for roughly half of the saving.

slides.title: On-call feedback
slides.quote: I slept through a deploy for the first time in two years.

slides.title: Plan for Q1
items: Alert on error budget burn, not on raw errors
Retire the last two hand-run release scripts
